name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: An Apple internal update took down iCloud, App Store and Apple Pay worldwide on 17 Nov; Chase had an outage on 16 Nov
state: Apple said an internal update caused worldwide outages on the morning of 17 Nov hitting iCloud sign-in, the App Store and Apple Pay; some account services were still affected hours later, and Apple denied a cyberattack (IBTimes UK). JPMorgan Chase online accounts and transactions failed on 16 Nov, which Chase blamed on a software bug (The National News Desk). Officials say the outages appear unrelated. A payments-linked outage of several hours within 48h sets Watch.
for_you: Keep an alternative way to pay and check providers' status pages during outages.
rubric_hit: Major payments outage > 2h in past 48h (Apple Pay, 17 Nov) = Watch

sources.title: IBTimes UK — Apple denies cyberattack after internal update causes worldwide outages
KOMO (National News Desk) — A wave of outages hits US companies and government systems

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
